diagnosis: visit_ListComp binds each item and unconditionally appends its element, ignoring comp.ifs. This explains both observed failures: case 00 produced [4,10,20,30,40] instead of [2,30,40,-777,-777], and case 02 produced [6,0,1,2,3,4,5] instead of [2,2,4,-777,-777,-777,-777]. The passing control, case 01, produced [4,10,20,30,40], as expected when every entry passes. Evaluate predicates in order after binding each item, short-circuit on the first false predicate, and evaluate and append the element only when all predicates pass. Unwrap constexpr predicates and reject runtime tensor predicates because the result length must be determined during compilation. This preserves input order and leaves unused output capacity untouched through the existing kernel stores. Compilation and post-patch device results are unavailable; held-out behavior has not been verified.
